reference_map_policy.description: A separate chemistry-free 100 ns trajectory may be used only to regenerate the previously accepted fixed Maxwell field map.
reference_map_policy.forbidden_use: The 100 ns state/checkpoint must not initialize or recover the production RF+dissociation trajectory.

acceptance: RF source is enabled from INITIAL
R_diss_O2 is positive from the first reported state
implicit O2 plus explicit O heavy-mass source closes
plasma state remains finite and positive
claim_boundary: A successful run is a bounded 0-to-110 ns RF+dissociation integration result, not long-time powered oxygen ICP validation.
